mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate trend compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or correlation with 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% or Rank IC for trigger condition < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate signals recession risk from monetary policy response to labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary easing during labor market stress
failure_condition: Interaction term (FEDFUNDS trend * UNRATE trend) has insignificant negative coefficient (p > 0.05) or Rank IC for interaction < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment recovery (UNRATE > 8.0%), improving labor market conditions drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days as corporate earnings rebound.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >40% of periods where UNRATE > 8.0% or Rank IC for regime condition < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate consistently signals labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for UNRATE trend falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or correlation with 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1000 thousand units, it indicates weakening residential demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days as economic contraction accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where HOUST < 1000 or Rank IC for trigger condition < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production signals broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST trend * INDPRO trend) has insignificant negative coefficient (p > 0.05) or Rank IC for interaction < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic supply chain normalization (INDPRO > 95.0), industrial production recovery stabilizes corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >40% of periods where INDPRO > 95.0 or Rank IC for regime condition < 0.03.
